items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild, requiring immediate hotfix application and credential rotation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. This bulletin includes CVE-2026-76200 and CVE-2026-76201, which are critical Stored XSS vulnerabilities.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An authorization bypass flaw allowing a low-privileged authenticated attacker to read select data by bypassing security features. SentinelOne describes its impact as critical, though the CVE was originally published in 2025.

items.title: Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing an attacker to take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API. Adobe has released a hotfix and is aware of exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges. Indications have emerged that threat actors are attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: A security update addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. This bulletin includes CVE-2026-71362 and other high-severity issues.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) that could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Adobe Commerce B2B, part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B. It could enable a security-feature bypass and requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) that could enable a security-feature bypass. This vulnerability requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 6.5) that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 2.7) that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: CosmicSting - Arbitrary File Read and Remote Code Execution
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) allowing attackers to read arbitrary files, such as encryption keys, and potentially achieve remote code execution when combined with another bug. Sansec reports active exploitation with stores being hacked at a high rate.
